searchSchema.description: Variable frequency drives. Engineers typically size VFDs to an exact motor HP and electrical service, so this category uses filters only -- no tolerance-based targets apply.

notes: At minimum, VFD shall include 5% impedance via 5% AC line reactor or dual DC bus chokes sized to 5% equivalent impedance.  VFD input Amps shall not exceed VFD output Amps.
VFD shall include alpha-numeric keypad interface, with display in plain English.  (Displays relying solely on codes are not acceptable).
Provide internal EMI/RFI filter per IEC 61800-3.
VFD shall be BTL Listed for BACnet MS/TP, and also include Modbus and N2.
VFD shall include real time clock with battery backup (include 10 year battery).
Phase Loss Protection & Broken Belt (loss of load) indication while in Bypass.
Bypass Contactors shall be powered by Switch Mode Power supply, allowing +30% to -30% Input Voltage Tolerance.  (120 V CPT not allowed).
VFD and Bypass shall both include BACnet MS/TP, Damper Control and Fireman’s override functionality.
Bypass operation to auto-reset after a brown out condition.
Include fast acting drive isolation fuses.
Bypass shall be fully functional in the event of a VFD failure.  Bypass shall not relay on the VFD or the VFD’s control board/relays.
Passive harmonic filter shall be factory mounted in the same enclosure as the VFD.
Passive harmonic filter shall include capacitor drop-out contactor.
Passive harmonic filter shall reduce harmonics to 5% THiD, measured at the filter lugs, while operating at full load.
System to meet IEEE 519-2014 based on the harmonic mitigation method(s) identified in the above schedule
